column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a contribution” is rendered “a district,” and NKJV supplies “cubits.”
Close to the Hebrew; the Hebrew gives no unit for “five hundred by five hundred”; NKJV supplies “rods.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the house” is rendered “the temple.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the land they will give” is rendered “they shall give the rest of the land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your evictions” is rendered “stop dispossessing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the well-watered land” is rendered “the rich pastures.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will be [obligated] to this contribution” is rendered “shall give this offering.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from anyone who errs” is rendered “for everyone who has sinned unintentionally.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a festival of weeks of days” is rendered “a feast of seven days.”
